newsitem.title: ANGOLA: Angolan troops withdrawn from trouble spot.
newsitem.headline: Angolan troops withdrawn from trouble spot.

text.p: Angolan President Jose Eduardo dos Santos has ordered government troops in Bie province to return to barracks to avoid clashing with opposition UNITA fighters, a U.N. official said.
"The president has personally ordered troops back to their barracks in Bie after tensions in the area with UNITA," said the official, who asked not to be identified.
Another U.N. official said UNITA had lodged an increased number of complaints of government ceasefire violations in the central province in the last month.

In terms of a peace accord signed between the two sides in November 1994, all government troops should already be back in their barracks and UNITA fighters should have reported to U.N.- run assembly camps.
